_meta.name: nas_best_t221
_meta.description: Architecture found by NAS — trial 221, fitness 6.8896. Plug-and-play compatible with architectures/default.json: drop this file into architectures/ or load with NEURAXON_ARCH=path/to/this.json python main.py
notes: Sections inherited from default.json:  healthy_bands (unchanged target ranges)
Sections overridden by NAS:  biology, neural, operating_ranges, genetic_lottery

biology._doc: Game-world / bio-inspired dynamics. Independent of neural architecture — change these to study survival pressure without touching the brain.
biology._doc_metabolic_ramp_per_sec: Multiplier added to food drain and metabolic_rate per second of idle. With 1s idle → factor (1 + 10*1) = 11×. Capped by max_atrophy.
biology._doc_max_atrophy: Hard cap on the atrophy multiplier (v151 fix). 5.0 = max 5× normal drain even after extended idle.
biology._doc_metabolic_rate_abs_cap_multiple: Absolute ceiling on the per-NxEr metabolic_rate, expressed as a multiple of the initial value (v153 F-1).
biology._doc_food: Defaults if the user doesn't change them via the menu sliders. The menu still overrides at startup.
biology._doc_idle_explore: v152 idle-exploration safety net. If an NxEr has been idle ≥ idle_explore_seconds, with explore_probability per tick, override motor output with a random direction.

neural._doc: Network architecture (topology + per-neuron parameters). Change these to test different brain configurations.
neural._doc_neuron_counts: Inputs: 10 sensory channels (movement, encounter, terrain, hunger, sight, smell, daynight, temp, proprio, song). Outputs: 7 motor (MoveX, MoveY, Social, MateIntent, GiveFood, Resting, Sing).
neural._doc_sensorimotor_coupling: v164 — multiplier on input→output direct-edge probability. 0.0 = pre-v164 (uniform random links). 1.0 = 2x more sensory→motor connections. 3.0 = 4x. The fitness component sensory_motor_corr was stuck near zero in 1425 v163 trials because there was no architectural bias for sensory pathways. Boost this and plasticity will amplify the correlations.
neural._doc_symmetric_stdp: v169 (v4.77) — opt-in for MultiNeuraxon2 Bug #3 fix. False (default) preserves v161-v168 asymmetric STDP where state==-1 is invisible to plasticity (only +1-driven correlations strengthen synapses). True enables signed STDP traces + symmetric (-1,-1) → LTP and (-1,+1) → LTD branches. Hypothesised to address the input saturation root cause we worked around with sm_corr_peak in v165. NAS will A/B test it.
neural._doc_refractory_period_ticks: v171 (v4.79) — number of ticks a neuron is FORCED to state=0 after each firing event (0→±1 transition). 0 = no refractory (v161-v170 behaviour). The v170 @2400s membrane diagnostics showed only 0.6% of samples at state=0 — the network had become a bistable +1/-1 oscillator with no rest band. The paper's trinary firing model REQUIRES a meaningful 0 state. This parameter restores it. NAS searches 0-12 ticks; biologically realistic values are 1-5 (~ 1-5 game ticks at 10Hz). The membrane potential continues to evolve during refractory so the neuron can fire again immediately after the buffer expires.
neural._doc_thresholds: Membrane firing thresholds (above which trinary_state = +1, below -threshold = -1). The membrane potential is a low-pass filter with intrinsic_timescale ticks. resting_potential_decay multiplies mp by (1-this) each tick before the membrane equation update.

operating_ranges._doc: Plasticity / adaptation / brake tunables. Change these to test different learning dynamics.
operating_ranges._doc_adaptation: v149: adapt builds toward 0.55 × multiplier when firing. Tau=20 ticks. Excitatory uses 1.5× to bias the brake against +1 dominance.
operating_ranges._doc_autoreceptor: Per-neuron autoreceptor that subtracts from theta1_eff (v154 sign back to v152 form — see CHANGELOG_v154 for context).
operating_ranges._doc_sensory_boost: v152 saturating cap: boosted_external = scale * tanh(scale * external_input). Asymptote = scale. 1.0 keeps strong inputs near threshold; lowering compresses further.
operating_ranges._doc_plasticity_brake: v152: when input_saturation_fraction > brake_threshold, learning_rate_mod is multiplied by max(floor, 1 - slope*(sat-threshold)).

genetic_lottery._doc: v162 — per-NxEr trait variation at birth. Each NxEr samples its own value from these ranges, creating the genetic diversity that selection acts on (the missing ingredient that kept M10 heritability at 0 across all 743 v161 NAS trials). Inheritance + mutation at mating carries traits across generations.
genetic_lottery._doc_metabolic_rate_multiplier_range: At birth each NxEr samples a multiplier uniformly from this range and applies it to its base metabolic_rate. [0.85, 1.15] means ±15% variation. Wider = more diversity but also more individuals at survival extremes.
genetic_lottery._doc_intrinsic_timescale_jitter: At birth each NxEr adds a uniform random value in [-jitter, +jitter] to intrinsic_timescale_default. 0.0 = no per-NxEr variation (all neurons in all NxErs have same timescale).
genetic_lottery._doc_firing_threshold_jitter: Same idea for firing_threshold_excitatory / inhibitory. 0.04 = ±0.04 around the architecture default of 0.55. 0.0 = no per-NxEr variation.
genetic_lottery._doc_mutation_strength: When offspring inherit a genetic trait from a parent, the value is perturbed by ±mutation_strength × (parent_value). 0.05 = 5% perturbation. 0 = exact copy.

healthy_bands._doc: Target ranges shown on the dashboard. NxErs operating in these bands are coloured green.
